subject: [PATCH v3 10/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Don't use freed hostdata while polling devices

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mpt3sas driver where it uses freed hostdata while polling devices, leading to potential crashes or data corruption. The fix involves taking block_lock before each TUR (Target Reset) operation and checking if the hostdata is still valid. If not, polling stops immediately. Additionally, target fields are copied into a separate structure to prevent accessing freed memory. This patch also updates other worker-side walkers that block or unblock sdevs to take block_lock for synchronization.
